title: Location: Settlement Peril
description: To reveal the nature of a perilous event or complication on a journey through a settlement, such as when you Undertake a Journey and roll a miss, use this oracle.

data.value: A pickpocket lifts something of value
Guards demand a bribe or detain you for questioning
You are caught up and jostled by a heaving crowd
A merchant cheats or shortchanges you
Provisions or gear go missing in the crush
You are refused entry at a gate or checkpoint
A local official levies an unexpected fee or tax
A con artist draws you into a losing scheme
You are marked as an outsider and watched
A creditor or old rival recognizes you
A drunkard or lout picks a fight
A brawl spills into the street around you
A gang corners you in a narrow alley
A patrol presses you for papers or service
Your lodging is robbed while you are away
You are accused of a crime you did not commit
A curfew traps you on the wrong side of a gate
Sickness is spreading through the district
You are drawn into a duel you cannot refuse
A festival crowd turns suddenly to panic
A powerful local figure takes offense at you
Thieves case you and shadow you through the streets
A checkpoint search turns up something incriminating
You are swept into an angry mob against your will
A fire breaks out and spreads toward you
You are arrested and thrown into a cell
A riot erupts and engulfs the district
Plague empties the streets and bars the gates
An assassin or thug marks you as a target
A building collapse blocks your escape
A supernatural blight creeps through the settlement
A mana disturbance sows chaos among the crowd
Someone among the Touched turns hostile
A dreadful apparition drives folk to terror
A curse or haunting grips a quarter of the town
A supernatural entity seeks vengeance or absolution
